keys: # 幸存者台词（文案 23_幸存者台词.md）。只在第 7 周遇到线、音频收发器修好时出现。

zh: 这台机器是谁派来的？你们是哪个避难所的？
en: Who sent this machine? Which shelter are you from?

zh: 在下面。（他指了指脚下）上面待不久，得戴着这个。（他敲了敲自己的面罩）
en: Down below. (He points at his feet.) You can't stay up here long. You have to wear this. (He taps his mask.)

zh: 这片地突然有机器在干活，我们以为是别的避难所的人来了。不知道你们想干什么，就先过来看看。
en: Machines suddenly started working on this land. We thought people from another shelter had come. We didn't know what you wanted, so we came to look first.

zh: 你那片绿地的苗，是我们拿的。那种苗我们没见过，想弄清楚是谁种的。
en: The seedlings from your green patch, we took them. We'd never seen that kind. We wanted to know who planted them.

zh: 入口那边放着干扰器，防旧机器靠近的。我回去跟他们说，给你的机器让条路。
en: There's a jammer by the entrance, to keep old machines away. I'll go tell them to let your machine through.

zh: 这座温室以前能种东西。玻璃补上，外面的花粉就进不来。你的机器能修，我们出人，也出些料。
en: This greenhouse used to grow things. Patch the glass and the pollen outside can't get in. Your machine can fix it; we'll bring people and some materials.

zh: 还你的。在下面养不好，还是这里的土合适。
en: These are yours. They don't do well down below. The soil here suits them better.

zh: 会。天上有一颗很亮的星，隔一阵就从这边划过去。大人说，那是旧时代留下的。
en: We do. There's a very bright star that crosses over here every so often. The adults say it's left over from the old times.
...It suddenly flashed just now. Really bright.

zh: 干扰器关了。跟我下来，让他们也看看你。
en: The jammer's off. Come down with me. Let them see you too.
